reviews.reasons: NO_PLAN is the right stance and the decisive gap is named correctly. All three openings hold only RECOMMENDATION facts: no buying signal, no price any buyer of this kind is shown to pay (the ManyPixels/Upwork benchmarks and the Clutch/Census counts were verified as not matching this buyer), and no close rate, so nothing establishes 8 x $1,500 = $12,000 settled by day 45. Brain's check agrees (NOT_VIABLE: $0 reachable at shown prices). The gap is missing evidence, not mis-stated as a constraint (constraints empty). Excluding the $299 GBP retainer and $120 Fiverr gig as carriers is arithmetically right: a $299 monthly retainer settles at most one or two payments per client in 45 days (~40 clients needed), and 100 Fiverr orders whose earnings clear 14 days after completion is not credible here. The suggested $147 test fits the $2,500 cap and the 4 h/week owner limit (1.5 h of calls).
findings: Arithmetic: 12,000 / 1,500 = 8 sales; test spend $47 + $100 = $147 (5.9% of the cap).

Calibrate the resolution's gate before running it: 2 deposits from 1,500 emails is a 0.13% rate, at which 8 sales need ~6,000 emails, above the 5,000/month Instantly Growth tier cited and hard to send from new domains inside the window. Passing the gate as written would not show $12,000 is reachable; the proof should be about 1 sale per ~190 emails (8/1,500) or the plan must show the sending volume.
Proof and stop thresholds leave a hole: proof needs a designer quote <= $700, stop fires only if none <= $900; a $701-$900 quote is neither.

Two unsourced feasibility assumptions in the test: (a) sending 1,500 cold emails on days 2-9 from freshly bought domains without warm-up, and (b) finding email addresses for businesses that by definition have no website. Both should be checked before the test is counted as a measurement.

Settlement after a pass is feasible: deposit at sale, balance on delivery ~10 days later, Stripe first payout 7-14 days after first live payment then ~2 business days; sales closed by about day 30 still settle by day 45.
decisiveLinks could also name FULFILMENT/ECONOMICS (subcontractor fee unknown; the test's quotes address it) and SETTLES_IN_TIME, which are equally unestablished on the card.
